data.title: Isolated Margin Trading for RLC, FTM, HIVE and DGB Enabled on Binance
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has enabled Isolated Margin trading for the following asset and trading pairs:

New Isolated Margin Assets: RLC, FTM, HIVE, DGB

New Isolated Borrowable Assets: RLC, FTM, HIVE, DGB

New Isolated Margin Pairs: RLC/BTC, RLC/USDT, FTM/BTC, FTM/USDT, HIVE/BTC, HIVE/USDT, DGB/BTC, DGB/USDT

We are also excited to announce a zero-interest promotion for borrowing RLC, FTM, HIVE and DGB from 2020/07/28 6:00 AM (UTC) to 2020/08/04 05:59 AM (UTC).

Further information:

  • Isolated margin trading rules
  • How to do margin trading

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2020/07/28

 

Trade on the go with Binance’s mobile crypto trading app:

Download for Android

Download for iOS

 

Find us on 

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/binance 

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/binance
